title: Fatepath
description: Constellation talents, random innates, and category Skill XP. Upgrade paths in combat, mining & fishing. Skill wheel, fireballs & cloud vortex. NeoForge 1.21.1.
body:

-----

This mod introduces four core concepts:

- Fate Thread: Unlocks exclusive talents and abilities; obtained with a low probability upon first entering a world timeline.
- Talent: Randomly granted a unique effect when first entering a world.
- Skill: Specialized proficiency gained by accumulating experience through corresponding gameplay channels and leveling up via the Fate Panel. Skills include passive buffs and prerequisites for unlocking spells.
- Spell: Active abilities equippable to the skill bar after unlocking the matching skill. Spells consume mana and are subject to cooldown restrictions.

_**This mod is currently in testing phase; load it with caution!**_

-----

模组引入了四个概念：

- 命运线：解锁独有的天赋与技能（首次进入世界线低概率获得）；
- 天赋：首次进入世界随机获得效果；
- 技能：通过对应类别渠道获得经验，在命途面板升级获得的专精能力，含被动加成与法术解锁条件；
- 法术：解锁对应技能后可装备到技能栏的主动能力，消耗魔力并受冷却限制；

**_模组目前处于测试阶段，请谨慎加载！_**
